summary: Step 0, the Seedance sync test: built tools/avsync.py, the OpenRouter client, the ledger module and the test runner (mock run first), print_grade.py, lipcheck.py and session_stats.py. The photoreal plates were refused by Seedance's real-person filter; colour print-graded plates passed, as ESCAPE VELOCITY's did. 6 clips, 2 covers and 2 sync-2-pro repairs, $9.70: the mouth follows Seedance's soundtrack, which starts the speech about 0.5 s into a clip and wanders 25-170 ms; covers can't pin a frame and keep the audio; sync-2-pro fixed the lips. Route approved: Seedance for the performance, sync-2-pro for the lips, the print texture kept. Updated BRIEF, PLAN, HANDOVER and the research note to it, after cold-read reviews of the docs and the tools (whose spending-safety defects were fixed). Counts include the two review subagents and five automatic commit reviews. Step 3, the build. A first attempt (Claude Code session 83bd7327, from 16:58) followed the superpowers workflow and was reverted; its counts are included. The rerun set up the permission allowlist with the user, then ran unattended: researched motion design, K-pop video direction and agent memes; wrote STYLE_BIBLE.md, with every fact on screen sourced; boarded the song in board.py (119 shots, 33 Seedance clips and 150 s, 67 plates, $59 expected with retakes and repairs); built the Remotion compositor in production/comp (the WebGL print pass, the lyric engine and its check, all 14 chapters' graphics, contact sheets, ANIMATION_GUIDE.md with a 1.5 s render budget per frame); built the pipeline (tools/paid.py's guard for the $150 pause and the $400 stop, the clip loop, and the p/b/m closure check calibrated on step 0's repairs: t3g 3 of 3, t2r 1 of 2; 32 tests against mocks); and rendered the animatic, 6,662 frames at 640x360 in 2 minutes. No paid calls. 15 decisions for checkpoint 1 are in QA_NOTES.md. Counts include the first attempt's 18 subagents and five automatic commit reviews. The canon check put her face on-model but every wide shot close, so wide and full-length plates took a distance canon (the user's OK). Fixes: reruns within the cap, Zoom Out 2x on three plates, and local crops, cobalt recolours and paint-outs (tools/plate_fix.py); 19 close-ups cropped to put her face on the prompt's side. The user flagged one face (A_desk_overhead), remade hands only. Depth maps for the 29 plates of 2.5D shots (Depth Anything V2 Large, tools/depth.py) and her face and body boxes on 51 plates (MediaPipe, Grounding DINO, tools/boxes.py). The two test clips ran the whole route, $4.74: C12 (three-quarter MCU) passed on take 1; C13 (MCU facing) passed once the closure check looked two frames either side of each letter (the user's call; clip_loop.py recheck, no new calls). 88 shots at plate, 2 synced.
